clues.text: Young David told Saul he had killed this animal, as well as a lion, to rescue lambs from his father's flock.
In Daniel's night vision of four beasts from the sea, the second looked like this animal, with three ribs in its teeth.
The beast John saw rising from the sea looked like a leopard, with a lion's mouth and this animal's feet.
God asked Job if he could lead out the star group named for this animal, along with her cubs.
Amos warned that the Day of the LORD is like a man fleeing a lion, only to run into this animal.
Hushai warned Absalom that David and his mighty men were as fierce as this wild animal robbed of her cubs.
When boys from Bethel mocked Elisha, two females of this animal came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of them.
